import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:logging/logging.dart';
import 'package:xta/client/client_unauthenticated.dart';
import 'package:xta/client/endpoints.dart';
import 'package:xta/client/headers.dart';
import 'package:xta/constants.dart';

// Temporary probe, copied into test/live by the workflow: does every live
// query id fail validation (not 404) when its variables are empty?
void main() {
  test('empty variables against every endpoint', () async {
    final token = await getToken(Logger('probe'));
    final client = http.Client();
    Future<void> probe(String label, Uri uri) async {
      final headers = await TwitterHeaders.getHeaders(uri, null);
      final response = await client.get(
        uri,
        headers: {...headers, 'authorization': guestBearerToken, 'x-guest-token': token},
      );
      final body = response.body.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' ');
      // ignore: avoid_print
      print('${label.padRight(24)} ${response.statusCode} ${body.substring(0, min(120, body.length))}');
      await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 1500));
    }

    for (final variables in ['{}', '']) {
      // ignore: avoid_print
      print('--- variables: "$variables"');
      for (final endpoint in XEndpoints.all) {
        await probe(
          endpoint.name,
          XEndpoints.uri(endpoint.name, {'variables': variables, 'features': '{}'}),
        );
      }
      for (final host in ['x.com', 'twitter.com']) {
        await probe(
          'MADE-UP on $host',
          Uri.https(host, '/i/api/graphql/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA/TweetDetail', {'variables': variables, 'features': '{}'}),
        );
      }
    }
  }, timeout: const Timeout(Duration(minutes: 4)));
}
